topic: Fundamental Constants and Mathematical Structure in Turbulence

sections.title: Introduction: The Chaos in the Coffee Cup
lecture_lines: Turbulence is a multi-scale, chaotic flow.
Energy injects at large, stable scales.
Eddies break down, transferring energy downward.
Smallest scales dissipate energy as heat.

sections.title: The Kolmogorov Scale: The Smallest Fingerprint
lecture_lines: The Kolmogorov scale is where viscosity dominates.
It is defined by ν and energy dissipation.
animations: Display a large vortex shape in green (#00FF00) surrounding a [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/fluid.svg].
Animate the vortex breaking into smaller green vortices.
Highlight tiny dots representing the viscosity scale (#00FF00) as observed through a [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/microscope.svg].

sections.title: The Mathematical Architecture: Scaling Laws
lecture_lines: Energy distributes across scales following a spectrum.
This describes the inertial range’s energy density.
animations: Show power-law equation: E(k) ~ k^(-5/3) in yellow (#FFFF00).
Animate a log-log plot revealing a -5/3 slope.
Color the inertial subrange on the plot in yellow.
Compare this slope to experimental data points derived from [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/sensor.svg].
Flash the exponent to emphasize the -5/3 value.

sections.title: The Role of Reynolds Number as a Scaling Constant
lecture_lines: Higher Re increases the range of scales.
Scale separation grows with Reynolds number.
animations: Display Re (Reynolds number) in white (#FFFFFF) text.
Animate a slider increasing Re from 100 to 10^6 through a [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/pipe.svg].
Transition flow visuals from laminar streamlines to turbulence around an [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/wing.svg].

sections.title: Conclusion: Universality of Turbulence
lecture_lines: These constants provide a universal structure.
Turbulence is a bridge to statistical mechanics.
It links deterministic equations to chaotic reality.
